definitions.explanation: A container for holding cut flowers.

examples.japanese: {花瓶|かびん}に{花|はな}を{生|い}ける。
examples.english: To arrange flowers in a vase.

examples.japanese: {花瓶|かびん}を{割|わ}ってしまった。
きれいな{花瓶|かびん}を{買|か}った。

notes:
{花瓶|かびん} is a container for displaying cut flowers.

ETYMOLOGY:
{花|はな/か} (flower) + {瓶|びん} (bottle/vessel).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {花瓶|かびん}に{花|はな}を{生|い}ける: to arrange flowers in a vase
- {花瓶|かびん}に{水|みず}を{入|い}れる: to put water in a vase
- {花瓶|かびん}を{割|わ}る: to break a vase

TYPES/MATERIALS:
- {陶器|とうき}の{花瓶|かびん}: ceramic vase
- ガラスの{花瓶|かびん}: glass vase
- {竹|たけ}の{花瓶|かびん}: bamboo vase

RELATED TERMS:
- {生|い}け{花|ばな}: ikebana (Japanese flower arrangement)
- {花|はな}を{生|い}ける: to arrange flowers
- {切|き}り{花|ばな}: cut flowers
- {一輪挿|いちりんざ}し: single-flower vase
